column3: MT 19:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
NKJV supplies “Where,” rendering “their voice is not heard” as “There is no speech nor language Where their voice is not heard,” reversing the sense of the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; אֹהֶל (“a tent”) is rendered “a tabernacle.”
Close to the Hebrew; תּוֹרַת (“instruction, torah”) is rendered “The law,” and “restoring life” “converting the soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; פִּקּוּדֵי (“the precepts”) is rendered “The statutes.”
Close to the Hebrew; נַקֵּנִי (“acquit me”) is rendered “Cleanse me,” and “hidden [sins]” “secret faults.”
Close to the Hebrew; צוּרִי (“my rock”) is rendered “my strength,” and “Redeemer” is capitalized.
